mapper.select: SELECT * FROM goods WHERE isDeleted = 0 ORDER BY stockQuantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT gc.id AS categoryId, gc.categoryName AS categoryName, SUM(g.stockQuantity) AS totalStock FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goodsCategory gc ON g.categoryId = gc.id WHERE g.isDeleted = 0 GROUP BY gc.id, gc.categoryName

SELECT g.goodsCode AS goodsCode, g.goodsName AS goodsName, g.stockQuantity AS stockQuantity, g.minStockWarning AS minStockWarning, g.maxStockWarning AS maxStockWarning, CASE WHEN g.stockQuantity <= g.minStockWarning THEN 'LOW' WHEN g.stockQuantity >= g.maxStockWarning THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS warningType FROM goods g WHERE g.isDeleted = 0 AND (g.stockQuantity <= g.minStockWarning OR g.stockQuantity >= g.maxStockWarning)

SELECT g.goodsCode AS goodsCode, g.goodsName AS goodsName, COALESCE(SUM(o.outboundQuantity), 0) AS totalOutbound, AVG(g.stockQuantity) AS avgStock, CASE WHEN g.stockQuantity > 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(o.outboundQuantity), 0) / g.stockQuantity ELSE 0 END AS turnoverRate FROM goods g LEFT JOIN outboundDetail o ON g.goodsCode = o.goodsCode AND o.isDeleted = 0 AND o.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) WHERE g.isDeleted = 0 GROUP BY g.goodsCode, g.goodsName, g.stockQuantity

SELECT g.goodsCode AS goodsCode, g.goodsName AS goodsName, SUM(o.outboundQuantity) AS totalOutbound FROM goods g LEFT JOIN outboundDetail o ON g.goodsCode = o.goodsCode AND o.isDeleted = 0 AND o.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) WHERE g.isDeleted = 0 GROUP BY g.goodsCode, g.goodsName ORDER BY totalOutbound DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.goodsCode AS goodsCode, g.goodsName AS goodsName, g.stockQuantity AS stockQuantity, ( SELECT MAX(o.createTime) FROM outboundDetail o WHERE o.goodsCode = g.goodsCode AND o.isDeleted = 0 ) AS lastOutboundTime FROM goods g WHERE g.isDeleted = 0 AND g.stockQuantity > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outboundDetail o WHERE o.goodsCode = g.goodsCode AND o.isDeleted = 0 AND o.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) )

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(i.inboundQuantity), 0) AS totalStock FROM inboundDetail i WHERE i.isDeleted = 0 AND i.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(i.createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
